items.sentence: One of the most interesting things to come out of the new psychological research on humans ___ the discovery that we are very bad judges of how we will feel in the future.
items.prompt: 문장 전체의 동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 주어의 중심은 One입니다. of the most interesting things ...는 주어를 길게 수식하므로 단수동사 is가 알맞습니다.
items.memory: One of + 복수명사 → 중심어 One에 맞춰 단수

items.sentence: One of the most interesting things to come out of the new psychological research on humans is the discovery that we are very bad judges of how we will feel in the future.
items.prompt: the discovery와 동격을 이루는 that절을 드래그하세요.
items.answer: that we are very bad judges of how we will feel in the future
items.explanation: that절은 the discovery의 구체적인 내용을 설명하는 동격절입니다.

items.sentence: A process of inquiry aimed at building a body of knowledge which is constantly open to rejection or confirmation produces science, not the affirmation of a set of beliefs.
items.explanation: aimed ...와 which is ...는 주어 A process of inquiry를 수식합니다. 이 수식어구를 모두 건너뛰면 produces가 본동사입니다.
items.structure: A process of inquiry (aimed ...) [which is ...] / produces science
